content: Neighbor Mention Compatibility Suppose neighbor mentions are topical coherent, a candidate entity shall also be compatible with neighbor mentions if it has a high compatibility score with the current mention, otherwise not. That is, we extract the vectorial global features by computing the similarities between INLINEFORM0 and all neighbor mentions: INLINEFORM1 , where INLINEFORM2 is the mention embedding by averaging the global vectors of words in its surface form: INLINEFORM3 , where INLINEFORM4 are tokenized words of mention INLINEFORM5 .
